title: Wonderful tour in Gracia neighborhood
text: This tour was excellent. We learned so much about the city’s history. Patrick is very knowledgeable and made it interesting and fun. He took us to the most important parts of the neighborhood and gave us a lot of useful information. We talked beyond history and in to present history and Catalan culture. It was great and really recommend him!
author: Gabriela_B

title: 5⭐️ Would recommend!!!
text:

He’s super knowledgeable, funny, and genuinely passionate about Barcelona and its history. We felt like we were exploring a neighborhood with a friend, rather than a usual tour.  He shared so many interesting stories and pointed out little details we never would have noticed on our own. author: Allison_A

title: Engaging Storyteller
text: I took a tour with Patrick in 2023 and when I found myself in Barcelona in February 2025, I booked another tour with him. My sister-in-law and I spent two delightful hours walking the Gothic quarter with Patrick. He’s an engaging storyteller making history come to life. If I find find myself in Barcelona again, I would love to tour with him a third time.
author: nacrowe

title: An Excellent Tour!
text: Our third private tour with Patrick — an excellent guide! Professional, knowledgeable of history and culture, full of interesting facts, a great storyteller. This quiet neighborhood with Patrick’s guidance is a good way to end one's time in Barcelona.
author: Beth_L

title: Informative and Fun
text: Patrick was an awesome guide. His local knowledge, flexibility and humor made the tour most interesting. Definitely recommended.
author: Charlie_B

title: A wonderful and informative tour!
text: We spent a wonderful morning on a private tour of the Gracia Village with Patrick. He tailored the tour to our experience (we had been a few of the places before, so he was able to go deeper for us), answered all of our questions, and was extremely knowledgeable. He is personable, a clear communicator, and generous with his time. We highly recommend him. If we had more time, we would take more of his tours!
author: LearningItalian

title: Fun and informative
text: Patrick was a wonderful guide. He shared interesting information that made the area come alive for us. And he took care to make sure we heard everything he said by facing us and speaking clearly and with enthsiasm.
author: Margaret B

title: Excellent private walking tour
text: Patrick is an excellent guide who is very knowledgeable as well as generous with his time.  In addition to the formal tour, he provided us with a lot of information on Barcelona  (e.g., tips on using the subway system) and on life in Spain.
author: Peter F
